feeding_claim.verbatim: Our animals are all raised on our land, moving around the pasture grazing and foraging.

notes: Family farm in Townsend, DE with an on-the-farm meat market (winter hours Saturday to Monday 10 am to 4 pm) and a Barn2Door online store. Checked 2026-11-15 the homepage, about, products, FAQ and contact pages. About page says all animals are raised on the farm's land, grazing and foraging on pasture, with about 90% born on the farm, and that the farm makes its own supplemental feed from farm-grown corn and seeds, so beef is not grass-only and the category is pastured. Chickens and turkeys are raised on pasture. Whole, half and quarter beef by contacting the farm; pork halves and quarters in the store. No delivery, shipping, markets or phone on the site. Also sells U-pick strawberries and hosts a fall festival.
